Proposed.Finding: ASA+AF filament retains all the advantages of classic ASA while offering even greater resistance to wear and mechanical damage . The material has a reduced coefficient of friction, which ensures increased resistance to abrasion (tribological wear). Thanks to its resistance to UV radiation and weather conditions, the material is ideal for outdoor applications, such as automotive parts, drone components, device housings, or components exposed to impacts and fluctuating temperatures. The filament is heat-resistant up to 94°C.

Proposed.Finding: Fiberlogy CPE ANTIBAC is a modern 3D printing filament that combines high mechanical and thermal strength with unique antibacterial properties. Thanks to the use of silver nanoparticles, the material effectively inhibits the growth of microorganisms on the surface of printed objects, as confirmed by microbiological tests. Fiberlogy CPE ANTIBAC demonstrated a complete (100%) reduction of E. coli and over a 92% reduction of Staphylococcus aureus in the initial test, and in repeat tests, its effectiveness remained at 100% and 97%, respectively.
